objective: Close the live LAN harvest failure caused by reading coordinates from Mineflayer's positionless palette-probe block while preserving the existing single bounded deterministic harvest action.
non_goals: Do not add a new model-selectable goal, generated route, coordinate authority, retry loop, exploration, crafting, collection loop, combat or manual gameplay control.
Do not let the model, renderer, HTTP caller or viewer call Mineflayer or mineflayer-pathfinder APIs directly.
Do not weaken exact-target diggability, physics freshness, tool selection, one-dig, postcondition, timeout, disconnect or emergency-stop checks.
contracts: Exact-target lookup uses Mineflayer's two-stage findBlock contract: the palette-safe matching callback checks only the allowlisted block name, while useExtraInfo alone checks the finite real-world position.
Harvest navigation retains the existing fixed GoalLookAtBlock, bounded movement policy, deadline and cancellation behavior.
A target-lookup, goal-construction or pathfinder failure emits one bounded owner-terminal diagnostic, then preserves the existing stable controller failure and performs no dig.

After navigation the deterministic controller still rechecks physics freshness, on-ground state and exact target diggability, selects only the fixed axe allowlist or empty hand, digs at most once and verifies the exact target disappeared.
allowed_dependencies: Existing pinned mineflayer 4.37.1 two-stage findBlock/useExtraInfo API and mineflayer-pathfinder 2.4.5 GoalLookAtBlock API; no new dependency.
oss_candidates: PrismarineJS/mineflayer and PrismarineJS/mineflayer-pathfinder official pinned packages; no upstream source copied.
acceptance_criteria: Mineflayer palette prefilter blocks with null position cannot reach a coordinate dereference or abort the deterministic goal.
The live LAN command can pathfind to and harvest one loaded allowlisted log without the null-position exact-target failure.
No-route, stale state, changed target, timeout, disconnect and emergency stop remain fail-closed before any unauthorized block mutation.
Minecraft adapter tests, module-brief validation, provenance guard, Desktop startup smoke and git diff check pass.
required_test_commands: uv run --frozen python -c "import json; from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator; schema=json.load(open('docs/schemas/module-brief.schema.json', encoding='utf-8')); brief=json.load(open('docs/modules/M09-S12A-exact-target-lookup-hotfix-module-brief.json', encoding='utf-8')); Draft202012Validator(schema).validate(brief)"

latency_or_quality_budget.target_lookup: one two-stage palette-safe lookup using the already loaded world
latency_or_quality_budget.path_search: one existing GoalLookAtBlock attempt; 40-block search radius and 30,000 ms controller deadline
latency_or_quality_budget.side_effect: at most one exact allowlisted log dig; no pathfinder block mutation or retry
